title: kate-syntax: keep the fallback selection color off the background
summary: selection_color already replaces a clashing TextSelection with a fixed blue. When that blue equals the background, the result is a second color. The theme files stay as they are. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust in the theme loader. Linux CI runs the test. It does not need a window or the owner's eyes.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Keep the PKT-0072 rule. TextSelection is used when it is set and it differs from BackgroundColor and from CurrentLine. Otherwise the first fallback is Rgba(0x94, 0xCA, 0xEF, 0xFF). When BackgroundColor is set and the chosen color equals it, return Rgba(0x00, 0x5F, 0xA8, 0xFF). When that second color also equals the background, return Rgba(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF) if that differs, and otherwise Rgba(0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0xFF). The returned color differs from BackgroundColor when that color is set. The existing selection_color test stays green. Breeze light still returns the first fallback. Leave the theme JSON files unchanged. Leave paint.rs unchanged. colors_from_theme still reads TextSelection. Leave layout.rs and notice.rs unchanged. PKT-0069 owns those files. Leave paint.rs unchanged. PKT-0071 owns that file. Leave fold.rs and view.rs unchanged. PKT-0073 owns those files. Leave command.rs and workspace.rs unchanged. PKT-0074 owns those files. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: theme::tests::fallback_selection_color_differs_from_the_background
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. A theme whose background and TextSelection are both #94CAEF returns the first fallback today, and that fallback equals the background. After the change the color is Rgba(0x00, 0x5F, 0xA8, 0xFF). That color differs from the background.
